title: The Blaschka Object Network — Global Archive Register
scope: Named archival collections, record groups, manuscript series, accession registers and institutional archives with demonstrated or high-priority relevance to Blaschka objects, orders, distribution, custody or afterlives. Object repositories without a specific archival trail are excluded until a usable source series can be named.

status_vocabulary.direct_blaschka_archive: The archival unit explicitly names Blaschka or is a dedicated Blaschka archive.
status_vocabulary.dealer_business_archive: Business archive of a documented Blaschka dealer or distributor.
status_vocabulary.direct_receiving_side_archive: Museum or institutional records explicitly document a Blaschka transaction, custody event or collection.
status_vocabulary.receiving_side_archive: Archive is directly tied to a Blaschka-holding institution and contains the relevant class of acquisition, accession, correspondence or museum records, but the decisive Blaschka item remains to be isolated.
status_vocabulary.candidate_archival_bridge: A named personal or institutional fonds is historically well positioned to close a known provenance gap, but a Blaschka-specific item has not yet been verified.
